learning.title: Contract source edits need both generators, and commit subjects stay short
learning.trigger: docs/technical-design/api-catalog.json or transport-schemas.json changes, or a commit hook rejects a subject.
learning.mistake: Running only pnpm contracts:generate left packages/contracts/generated/transport-schemas.ts and catalog-literals.ts stale, so a changed schema enum never reached the typed client. Long conventional-commit subjects were rejected by the commit hook.
learning.rule: After editing either contract source run pnpm catalog:literals (writes catalog-literals.ts and transport-schemas.ts), then pnpm contracts:generate (writes contracts.json and client-manifest.ts), and commit all four. Keep commit subjects at or under 72 characters. A deno-fmt'd transport-schemas.json is not byte-stable through json.dumps, so edit it as text.
